sentences.text:
September, 2024
 High Court Of Andhra Pradesh
 Main Case No: Crl.P.No.6335 of 2024
 Proceeding Sheet
NOTE 01. 12.09.2024 BVLNC,J  I.A.No.1 of 2024  Dispensed with for the present.
Crl.P.No.6335 of 2024  Heard learned counsel for the  petitioners.
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor  takes notice for the respondent No.1/State.
Issue notice to the unofficial respondent No.2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to the unofficial respondent No.2 through registered post with acknowledgment due and file proof of service in the Registry.

Sri D.Kodandarami Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that petitioners are A4 and A5 in PRC No.71 of 2019 on the file of learned II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
YSR Kadapa District.

entities.text:
II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class,
YSR Kadapa District
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He would further submit that initially FIR was registered against the present petitioners and others for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 498 read with 34 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act and Section 3(i)(x) of SC's & ST's (POA) Act, 1989.
The police conducted investigation and laid final report against the present petitioners before the learned magistrate, referring the case as false.
Later, the de facto complainant filed protest petition.
Learned Magistrate registered case against the petitioners as PRC No.71 of 2019 and against others as PRC No.04 of 2018.

He would submit that no case was made out even as per the police investigation and the other case was committed vide SC No.21 of 2020 on the file of learned IV Additional District & Sessions Judge cum Special Judge for trial of cases under SCs & STs (POA)
Act, Kadapa.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge cum Special Judge for trial of cases under
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Considering the above facts and circumstances submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner,
there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings against the petitioners herein in PRC No.71 of 2019 on the file of learned II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, YSR Kadapa District, for a period of eight (08) weeks.
